name: threads
description: Process tooling for Claude Code — two commands, one loop. /threads:retro reviews a session as process telemetry (how it happened, not whether the code is correct), by default via a fresh-context sub-agent that audits the observable record cold; a second fresh sub-agent places findings in the repo's process docs, biased to amend before add, and keys them against a retro log so "adopt if it recurs" is measured rather than hoped for. Retro captures findings to that log instead of applying them at the session's most expensive moment. /threads:process-review adjudicates what's pending, reads what accumulated across sessions — process-shaped commits, or process-doc churn as a fallback — surfaces reconciliation and structural candidates, and sweeps stable process/workflow docs for negative-space drift the churn signal can't see. No hooks; retro closes with a ripeness nudge instead. First runs bootstrap by inspection and negotiate conventions; nothing is applied without recorded consent.
